example.install_guide: From the Dex checkout, run `copilot plugin install ./packages/dex-agent-plugin`. Confirm Dex appears in `copilot plugin list`. Start the CLI from the Dex folder so the vault is the current working directory. The family PreToolUse refusal file is in the shipped package. Ubuntu Cloud is not a person opening this terminal. A detection test or green CI is not a live install.
example.vault_grant: Start the CLI from the Dex folder so the current working directory is the vault.
